dead_ends.hypothesis: unittest-parallel module-level execution is safe for all small legacy suites
dead_ends.outcome: Rejected: module-level parallelism across app test modules races shared import-time Frappe test doubles; fast-check python failed with 24 errors and 2 failures despite all tests running

cloud-benchmark-stale-count.fix_summary: Updated benchmark and guardrail evidence to the measured 477 total and 154 tools tests, with five added regression/guardrail tests

safeguard.summary: The benchmark evidence test now pins the corrected 477 total and 154 tools-suite counts.
safeguard.why_not_static: Count consistency depends on the content of the benchmark artifact and cannot be expressed by the existing Python AST static rules.

cloud-benchmark-stale-count.summary: Benchmark evidence still reported 475/152 after the two evidence-safeguard tests increased discovery to 477/154

cloud-cache-safeguard-shape.fix_summary: Strengthened the regression test to count uv bootstrap/cache settings per job and verify every dependency-manifest cache path

safeguard.summary: The strengthened cache safeguard counts per-job bootstrap and UV_CACHE_DIR entries and verifies each cache-dependency-path.
safeguard.why_not_static: The safeguard must inspect repeated YAML job configuration across two workflows; existing static lint rules do not model GitHub Actions job structure.

cloud-cache-safeguard-shape.summary: The uv cache safeguard only checked presence of UV_CACHE_DIR and did not verify per-job cache-dependency-path coverage

cloud-merge-result.fix_summary: Restored unconditional ordinary CI execution so pull_request merge results are always exercised; documented that labeled-PR skipping was a rejected optimization

safeguard.summary: Ordinary pull_request CI is architecturally unconditional, so merge-result verification cannot be skipped while candidate checks verify immutable heads.

cloud-merge-result.summary: Skipping ordinary CI for labeled autoloop PRs would leave merge-result behavior untested because candidate checks test only the immutable PR head

cloud-uv-cache-key.fix_summary: Added uv to the pinned dependency group so dependency-manifest cache keys rotate away from pre-uv pip-only entries; validated a fresh seven-package uv install in 0.39s

safeguard.summary: The uv safeguard requires the installer pin in the dependency manifest plus per-job cache paths and UV_CACHE_DIR coverage.
safeguard.why_not_static: The defect is an interaction between dependency manifests, generated cache keys, and multiple workflow jobs; no existing static lint rule evaluates that cross-file behavior.

cloud-uv-cache-key.summary: The setup-python cache key can exactly hit a pre-uv pip-only cache; exact hits are not resaved, so the uv cache remains cold and dev packages are downloaded every run

cloud-zizmor-online.fix_summary: Passed --offline to zizmor, added a regression test proving offline invocation, and verified injected template-injection detection offline

safeguard.summary: TestZizmorGate asserts the workflow scan always passes --offline and workflow collection arguments.
safeguard.why_not_static: Token-influenced network behavior depends on the exact runtime CLI invocation; repository static rules cannot execute the installed binary interface.

cloud-zizmor-online.summary: zizmor inherited GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN and could perform online audits, violating the offline fast-check contract in disconnected development

deep-test-count-claim.fix_summary: Corrected benchmark evidence to distinguish preserved baseline tests from three added regression tests and added the measured repeat/CI samples

safeguard.summary: The benchmark evidence test requires exact baseline and final discovery counts plus the explicit no-baseline-tests-removed claim.
safeguard.why_not_static: The evidence lives in run-specific markdown rather than a typed interface; a regression test is the executable check available without creating broader framework machinery.

deep-test-count-claim.summary: Benchmark and PR evidence say test count is unchanged even though the branch adds regression tests; the accurate claim is that no baseline tests were removed and total discovered tests increased

goal: Own Developer Productivity, CI/CD Performance and Verification Engineering for Embryo: maximize verified engineering output per hour, increase defect detection, reduce verification latency/token consumption/deployment time, preserve correctness
grill_summary: User invoked /autoloop and supplied autonomous scope, constraints, and acceptance criteria. Assumptions: use default routing/model roster, human merge mode, cloud+deep review enabled. Single focused shard may touch verification infrastructure, CI workflows, dependency metadata, tests, and benchmark/research artifacts. Non-goals: no ERP business logic, financial calculations, backend transaction processing, native Rust workspace, or competing orchestration framework. Measured baseline: local fast-check 9.46-9.66s with Python unittest discovery dominating (tools suite 6.02-6.47s sequential vs 3.52-3.70s using unittest-parallel class-level j=4); GitHub main CI 30s total, 7s fast-check, 12s dependency/Knip setup; zizmor 1.33.1 scans workflows in 0.16s and reported 19 baseline findings (16 unpinned actions, 2 credential persistence, 1 intentional issue_comment trigger). Implement only measured high-ROI improvements: parallel unittest execution through existing unittest-parallel, zizmor workflow security gate with explicit justified exception, dependency caching/de-duplication in CI, and evidence documentation.
